story.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿表示，近期在法拉利赛车的调校上不如勒克莱尔，导致自己损失了性能。美国大奖赛他获得第四，勒克莱尔获得第二。
story.originalTitle: 'Lots to take away' - Hamilton reveals area he's 'lost out' to Leclerc
story.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton said he has "lost out" to Charles Leclerc in the set-up of his Ferrari car in recent races, which has cost him performance. He finished fourth at the United States Grand Prix while Leclerc was second.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿表示，近期在F1比赛中，他的法拉利赛车调校不如勒克莱尔。
汉密尔顿觉得自己近期没有把法拉利赛车的调校做到最优，这让他损失了性能；汉密尔顿在周日的美国大奖赛获得第四，而勒克莱尔获得第二；本周五起，墨西哥城大奖赛的每一节练习与排位都将在天空体育直播。
克雷格·斯莱特对本站美国大奖赛发表看法：梅赛德斯车手安东内利强势夺冠，这位意大利车手只需在墨西哥大奖赛再拿两分，就能夺得历史性的首个世界冠军。
汉密尔顿表示，近期在法拉利赛车的调校上，他不如勒克莱尔。
在美国大奖赛中，勒克莱尔在排位赛中击败了汉密尔顿，汉密尔顿在正赛中无法匹配队友的惊人速度，最终获得第四名，而勒克莱尔则落后于分站冠军基米·安东内利获得第二名。
在上一站新加坡的比赛中，汉密尔顿在排位赛中表现强劲，直到第三节排位赛被勒克莱尔击败；奥斯汀站也出现了类似的情况，这位七届世界冠军在最后一次练习赛中排名第一，但最终只获得第五名。

“在过去五场左右的比赛中我丢了很多积分，”汉密尔顿对天空体育F1表示，他在车手积分榜上落后第二名乔治·拉塞尔一分。
“我认为问题出在赛车调校上，调校并不完美。这是我必须真正攻克的地方。我就是在这里吃了亏。就表现而言，我觉得自己一直开得很好，上一场[奥斯汀]的那段 stint 也不错。前两段 stint 我对此无能为力。
“肯定有很多需要总结的地方。车队做得很好，带来了升级。查尔斯拿到了第二名。我们有了不错的表现。希望去墨西哥时，我们能改进在调校上出错的地方。”
2026年美国大奖赛的精彩瞬间
法拉利在美洲赛道的大多数弯角中依然是标杆车队，但与梅赛德斯和红牛相比，缺乏直线速度。
但是，汉密尔顿对大奖赛前两段 stint 中赛车的低速平衡感到不满，这让他退出了领奖台的争夺。
“我损失了太多时间。尤其是在低速弯，我无法让赛车转向——1号弯、11号弯、12号弯、13号弯、14号弯、15号弯。严重的转向不足，所以当我调整设置时，[其他]赛车就拉开了距离，”他说。
“到我们进入最后一节时，我们更接近了平衡，但我们本应在开始时就用上那个平衡。学到了很多。车队在进站和策略方面做得非常出色。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿透露，他的法拉利赛车存在“严重”转向不足，这让他错失了美国大奖赛的第四名完赛。
勒克莱尔本可以赢得美国大奖赛吗？
勒克莱尔排位赛获得第四，但起步极为出色，在第一赛段超越了伊萨克·哈贾尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘，然而维斯塔潘在第一圈结束时又反超了这位法拉利车手。
法拉利为勒克莱尔选择了两次进站的策略，这让他在比赛尾声阶段超越了维斯塔潘和采用一次进站策略的兰多·诺里斯，但他最终落后安东内利13秒完赛。
勒克莱尔认为自己的排位赛名次让他错失了获胜机会，但即便他在正赛中遇到的交通状况更少，安东内利也“实在太快了”。
“如果你看看第一节、第二节和第三节练习，我们非常强。如果你看看排位赛，在第三节排位赛结束时，要让轮胎达到工作温度极其困难，我们很可能就是在那里失去了获胜的机会，”勒克莱尔说道。
“但基米非常强，所以，从整个周末来看，我认为我们就是不够稳健。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在奥斯汀的最后一节练习中力压马克斯·维斯塔潘排名第一。
法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔认为，在情况不同的前提下，勒克莱尔本可以赢得这场比赛。
“比赛进行得很顺利——竞速过程很顺利，速度还可以，我们在策略上很激进，因为我们必须超车，”瓦塞尔对天空体育F1表示。
“总的来说，如果说我们错过了什么，那就是Q3的最后两圈。那是这个周末最重要的几圈，问题就出在那里。
“总的来说，我想从周末中看到积极的一面，那就是从第一节练习到比赛最后一圈，速度一直都在。如果没有虚拟安全车，本来会是双领奖台，但我们还是争取在墨西哥跑出更好的排位赛并赢得比赛。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔对兰多·诺里斯和马克斯·维斯塔潘完成两次精彩超越
法拉利能在2026年再赢一场比赛吗？
2026赛季还剩五站，本周末首先进行墨西哥城大奖赛，由于赛道海拔2200米，海拔将成为影响因素。
法拉利动力单元在高海拔地区的表现将决定他们能否在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道争夺胜利，这条赛道拥有大量弯道，SF-26 应该会喜欢。
勒克莱尔表示：“差距非常细微，这也取决于其他车队在接下来比赛中的升级计划。但赛车的感觉越来越好。”
“这些赛车非常特殊且独特，我觉得在过去两三场比赛中，我在驾驶方面又解锁了一些东西，尤其是驾驶与调校的结合。两者结合在一起，我们向前迈出了一步，我对赛车的感觉舒服多了。”
“我希望这能很快带来一场胜利。无论是在新加坡还是奥斯汀，我们都非常接近，所以我有信心，我们会在赛季结束前有机会赢得一场比赛。”

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton reveals he's 'lost out' in recent F1 races with set-up of his Ferrari car compared to Charles Leclerc

Lewis Hamilton feels he's not optimised set-up of his Ferrari car recently which has cost him performance; Hamilton finished fourth in Sunday's US Grand Prix while Charles Leclerc was second; watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports

Craig Slater gives his verdict on the on United States GP, as a dominant win for Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli leaves the Italian needing just two points from the Mexico GP to claim an historic first world title
Lewis Hamilton has revealed he's "lost out" to Charles Leclerc through the set-up of his Ferrari car in recent races.

Hamilton was outqualified by Leclerc at the United States Grand Prix and was unable to match his team-mate's impressive pace in the race on his way to fourth, while Leclerc finished second behind race-winner Kimi Antonelli.

At the previous race in Singapore, Hamilton looked strong in qualifying until Q3 when he was beaten by Leclerc, and a similar pattern occurred in Austin where the seven-time world champion topped final practice, only to qualify fifth.

"I lost a lot of points in the last five races or so," Hamilton, who is one point behind second-placed George Russell in the Drivers' Championship, told Sky Sports F1.

"I think it has come from set-up, not perfect, the set-up. That's something I really have to get on top of. That's where I have lost out. Performance-wise I feel like I've been driving well and the last [race] stint [in Austin] was good. The first two stints there was nothing I could do about that.

"Definitely lots to take away. The team did a great job to bring an upgrade. Charles got a second place. We have got good performance. Hopefully when we go to Mexico, we can improve on where we have gone wrong on that setup."
Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix
Ferrari continued to be the benchmark team in most corners at the Circuit of the Americas but lacked straight-line speed compared to Mercedes and Red Bull.
But, Hamilton was unhappy with the car's low-speed balance in the first two stints of the Grand Prix which put him out of the podium fight.

"I lost so much time. I couldn't turn the car in the low-speed particularly - Turn 1, Turn 11, Turn 12, Turn 13, 14, 15. Massive understeer so the [other] cars pulled away when I was adjusting my settings," he said.

"By the time we got to the last stint, we got closer to the balance but we should have started with that balance at the beginning. Lots of learnings. The team did a great job with pit stops and strategy."
Lewis Hamilton revealed that his Ferrari had 'massive' understeer, which cost him a fourth-place finish at the United States Grand Prix
Could Leclerc have won United States GP?
Leclerc qualified fourth but had a superb start by overtaking Isack Hadjar and Max Verstappen in the first sector, only for Verstappen to overtake the Ferrari driver at the end of the first lap.

Ferrari opted for a two-stop strategy with Leclerc which saw him charge past Verstappen and Lando Norris, who did a one-stop race, in the closing stages but he ultimately finished 13 seconds behind Antonelli.
Leclerc believes his qualifying position cost him a chance at victory but even if he had less traffic to contend with in the race, Antonelli was "just too quick".

"If you look at FP1, FP2 and FP3, we were very strong. If you look at qualifying, at the end of the day in Q3, it was extremely difficult to bring the tyres up to temperature, and we probably lost a shot at the victory there," said Leclerc.
"But Kimi was very strong, so, as a whole weekend, I think we're just not robust enough."
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice in Austin from Max Verstappen
Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur believes Leclerc could have won the race in different circumstances.
"The race went well - the racing went well, the pace was OK, we were aggressive with the strategy because we had to overtake," Vasseur told Sky Sports F1.
"Overall, if we missed something it was the last two laps in Q3. That was the most important laps of the weekend and that's where we had the issue.

"Overall, I want to take the positive of the weekend that the pace was there from FP1 to the last lap of the race. Without the VSC it would have been a double podium but let's try to do a better qualifying in Mexico and win the race."
Charles Leclerc makes two great overtakes on Lando Norris and Max Verstappen
Can Ferrari win another race in 2026?
Five rounds remain in the 2026 season with the Mexico City Grand Prix up first this weekend, where altitude will be a factor given the track is 2,200m above sea level.

The performance of the Ferrari power unit at altitude will dictate if they can challenge for victory at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, which features lots of twisty corners which the SF-26 should enjoy.
"It's such fine margins, and it also depends on what the upgrade plans of the others are in upcoming races. But the feeling with the car is getting better and better," said Leclerc.

"These cars are very specific and unique, and I feel like, over the last two or three races, I've unlocked something again in terms of driving, and particularly setup with my driving. Just both together, we've taken a step forward, and I just feel much more comfortable with the car.
"I hope that this will result in a win soon. Whether it's in Singapore or in Austin, we were quite close, so I'm confident that we'll have a shot to win a race before the end of the season."

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."
Charles Leclerc says he's 'settled' feud with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton after their clash in last week's Mexico City GP

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their incident in Mexico
Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。

圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
